name: Lianyou Metals Co. Ltd.
summary: Lianyou Metals Co., Ltd. focuses on the smelting, fabrication, and global distribution of advanced powder metallurgy products and bulk industrial hardware components. The company also conducts international trading operations across Taiwan, Japan, China, and other international markets. Furthermore, a core part of their business involves the production and processing of specialized materials like sodium tungstate, tungsten lumps, and cobalt carbonate. Established in 2018, Lianyou Metals maintains its headquarters in Pingtung, Taiwan.
